# AMD OpenGL: crash after closing NT handles imported with GL_EXT_memory_object_win32 / GL_EXT_semaphore_win32

## Summary

On Windows, AMD's OpenGL driver (`atio6axx.dll`) crashes with an access violation on a driver worker thread when the application closes the NT handles it passed to `glImportMemoryWin32HandleEXT` and `glImportSemaphoreWin32HandleEXT` right after those calls returned.

EXT_external_objects_win32 allows that: "Importing a Windows handle does not transfer ownership of the handle to the GL implementation. For handle types defined as NT handles, the application must release the handle using an appropriate system call when it is no longer needed." The driver appears to finish the import asynchronously and use the handle after the import call returned.

The crash is a user-mode access violation in the application's process, caught by Windows Error Reporting (Application log event 1000, faulting module `atio6axx.dll`). The GPU does not hang and no TDR happens, so AMD Software's own crash reporting does not show it.

## Repro

`main.cpp` is a single file with no dependencies besides the Vulkan headers. It loads `vulkan-1.dll` and `opengl32.dll` at run time.

```
x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ -O1 -std=c++17 -I<Vulkan-Headers>/include main.cpp -o gl_interop_repro.exe -lgdi32 -lopengl32 -static
clang++ -O1 -std=c++17 -I<Vulkan-Headers>/include main.cpp -o gl_interop_repro.exe -lgdi32 -lopengl32 -luser32
```

1. It creates a window with a plain `wglCreateContext` context, and a Vulkan 1.1 device on the same GPU, matched by LUID.
2. It creates one 640x480 `R8G8B8A8_UNORM` optimal-tiling image (mutable format, every usage) in dedicated memory exported as `OPAQUE_WIN32`, then imports it with `glCreateMemoryObjectsEXT`, `GL_DEDICATED_MEMORY_OBJECT_EXT = TRUE`, `glImportMemoryWin32HandleEXT(size = allocationSize)` and `glTexStorageMem2DEXT(GL_RGBA8)`. Then it calls **`CloseHandle`**.
3. It does the same for two binary `OPAQUE_WIN32` semaphores with `glImportSemaphoreWin32HandleEXT`, each followed by **`CloseHandle`**.
4. For 300 frames, Vulkan clears the image and releases it to `VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_EXTERNAL` in `GENERAL`. OpenGL then calls `glWaitSemaphoreEXT(GL_LAYOUT_GENERAL_EXT)`, `glBlitFramebuffer` into the window, `glSignalSemaphoreEXT`, `glFlush` and `SwapBuffers`.

| Command | Expected | AMD result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gl_interop_repro.exe` | `RESULT: OK` | `CRASH: exception 0xc0000005 at ...atio6axx.dll+0x...` |
| `gl_interop_repro.exe --keep-handles` | `RESULT: OK` | `RESULT: OK` |

The only difference between the two is when `CloseHandle` is called. All GL calls report `GL_NO_ERROR` before the crash.

## Results

From a larger variant of this program (scratch branch `claude/amd-gl-interop-repro`, `tools/repro/amd-gl-interop/`), run more than 30 times.

**System:** Windows 10.0.26300, laptop with AMD switchable graphics:

| GPU | Adapter driver | atio6axx.dll | GL_VERSION | Crash site |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Radeon RX 6600M (Navi 23, RDNA 2, 0x73FF) | 32.0.21045.29003 | 26.11.250223_d1f9d32 | 4.6.0 Compatibility Profile Context 26.11.2.261112 | `+0x216c920`, writing 0x20, driver thread, first `glWaitSemaphoreEXT` or `glFinish` |
| Radeon Graphics (Vega, Cezanne, 0x1638) | 31.0.21925.1001 | 26.04.230729_569461f | 4.6.0 Compatibility Profile Context 26.5.2.260413 | `+0x2155700`, writing 0x20, driver thread, during the imports |

Stack of the RX 6600M crash: `atio6axx+0x216c920 <- +0xad9882 <- +0x962f9a <- +0x962236 <- +0x3a4914 <- +0x96f469 <- +0x915c92 <- +0x8f35b1 <- +0x5caa9f <- +0x108da33 <- KERNEL32+0x2dda7 <- ntdll+0xc9c5c`

| Variant | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Handles closed right after import | crash on both GPUs |
| The same with a 4.6 core context, linear tiling, no semaphores, no blit, or minimal image usage | crash, same offsets |
| All NT handles kept open until the GL objects are deleted | OK (3000 frames) |
| `glFinish()` before each `CloseHandle` | OK |
| Only the semaphore handles kept open | crash at `+0x216c920` |
| Only the memory handles kept open | RX 6600M: `GL_INVALID_OPERATION` after each `SwapBuffers`, and `vkQueueSubmit` fails on frame 3. Vega: read of address 0 at `+0xa8f225` in `glWaitSemaphoreEXT` |
| `OPAQUE_WIN32_KMT` handles | OK on both GPUs |
| NVIDIA RTX 4070 Laptop, driver 621.24, handles closed right after import | OK |

Not tested yet: RDNA 3 or newer with OpenGL on the AMD GPU.

**Side note:** both AMD GPUs report the same `GL_DRIVER_UUID_EXT` / Vulkan `driverUUID` (`414d442d57494e2d4452560000000000`, "AMD-WIN-DRV"), although they run different driver builds.

## Expected behaviour

Either the import is complete when the call returns, or the driver duplicates the handle, so that the application can close it right away as the extension allows.

## Workaround

Keep the NT handles open until the OpenGL memory objects and semaphores are deleted (BlitzLLVM #665).
